fields.title: Interpolation precision
fields.finding: All design-day float/least-set conclusions agree, but a full direct recomputation finds endpoint table differences above .05 kg, up to approximately .23814 kg. Selected decision-critical checkpoints remain much closer.
fields.missing_evidence: Say 'selected checkpoints within .05 kg' and retain the exact direct/interpolated ledger.
